Outline · not written yet

This is the planned structure of the chapter, published so the curriculum can be reviewed before the prose is written. Each heading below becomes a section; the last section is what you will build and test. About 65 minutes when written.

12.1 · Evaluate the parts separately

retrieval, grounding, and answer quality fail independently.

12.2 · Retrieval metrics

recall@k, MRR, nDCG, derived and computed on one example.

12.3 · Groundedness and faithfulness

is every claim supported by the retrieved context?.

12.4 · Citation correctness

the cited passage must support the sentence that cites it.

12.5 · Building retrieval labels cheaply

pooled judgments and synthetic queries, with their biases.

What you build

A RAG eval that reports retrieval, grounding and answer scores per query. Every number it produces is asserted by a test, and the chapter's companion notebook recomputes it.
